entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello? I need to return an item I bought.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly look into that for you. Which item are you calling about today?
It's the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. It's not working right.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. This thing is garbage. It won't sync with my phone, and the heart rate is all over the place. Honestly, I don't have time to mess with it, I just want my money back.

I can definitely understand your frustration when a new device isn't working as expected. For any defect claims, our first step is to connect you with our technical support team. They can verify the fault and authorize a replacement or return. Would you like me to transfer you?
No. I really don't have time for a 30-minute troubleshooting call. They'll just make me turn it off and on again. I want a refund, that's it.

I see. I've pulled up your order details, and it looks like the VeloBand was delivered 12 days ago. I do need to let you know that the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return policy due to the way it activates and for hygiene reasons.
Since we are outside that 10-day window and we can't verify a technical fault without troubleshooting, I am unable to process a return for a refund at this time.
Okay, I hear you on the 10-day policy. That seems a bit short, but it is what it is. Look, I'm a good customer. Can we meet in the middle here? What about a 50% store credit? I'd be happy with that.

I appreciate you working with me on this, and I do see you've shopped with us before. Unfortunately, the system is very strict on that 10-day return window for the Pulse and doesn't allow me to issue partial credits for it.

What I can suggest is our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. Many customers who are just outside their return window are able to sell their devices there and recoup most of the cost. It's a very active community.
The marketplace, huh? That's more work for me. How about this: just give me a 25% off coupon for the inconvenience, and I'll go list it myself. That seems like a fair compromise.

I wish I could offer a coupon, but my system doesn't allow for goodwill credits on returns that fall outside the policy window. The Resale Marketplace is truly the best solution I can provide right now. I can email you the direct link.
Alright, fine. Send me the link. I'll figure it out. Thanks, I guess.
Of course. I've just sent that link to the email on your account. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
